abilities.name: Dauntless Instinct
notes: Spell shield will block the mark's application, but not the mark's consumption from an attack.
The empowered attack can be dodged, blocked, and missed while blinded but the mark will not be consumed.

All Out's bonus damage on abilities only applies to the first target hit when damaging multiple enemies (including minions and monsters).
  - For most of K'Sante's spells and item effects, in the case of multiple targets being stuck on the same game tick, this refers to the closest target. For non-missile Ntofo Strikes, it instead depends on the order in which the target units were spawned into the match.

abilities.name: All Out

evidence.quote: airborne: knock back

He then shatters his ntofos, pulling the target to a location that is 300 units in the cast direction from their location at the time of cast, during which they are revealed, and blinking 175 units behind that location.
root
Active: K'Sante roots the target enemy champion for 0.5 seconds and gains displacement immunity over the cast time.
stun
The target is dealt physical damage near the end of the displacement and is stunned for 0.3 seconds once it ends.
Active: K'Sante roots the target enemy champion for 0.5 seconds and gains displacement immunity over the cast time.

notes:
While the target is being pulled over terrain, they are additionally attached to a missile that travels in the same trajectory as the displacement, detaching them afterwards.
  - Removing the airborne debuff will not cause the target to detach from the missile.
  - The missile attaches the target to itself a second time at the end of the displacement, before detaching them (for a total of two attach instances).

If the target resists the pull by having a spell shield or being immune to crowd control or displacement immune, K'Sante will still blink beyond the pull's end location as if the target were displaced.

All Out's granted untargetability from the vanish during the target's pull does not destroy in-flight projectiles.* If the target becomes untargetable, dies, or is too far away or no longer in sight during the cast time, this ability will cancel but does not go on cooldown nor pay its cost (if applicable).
